scripts.test: npm run clean && npm run test:${PROFILE:-integration}
scripts.test:debug: npm run clean && DEBUG=true CUCUMBER_EXTRA_TAGS='@debug' wdio run wdio.conf.js
scripts.test:smoke: npm run clean && CUCUMBER_EXTRA_TAGS='@smoke' wdio run wdio.conf.js
scripts.test:integration: npm run clean && CUCUMBER_EXTRA_TAGS='not @smoke' wdio run wdio.conf.js
scripts.test:browserstack: npm run clean && CUCUMBER_EXTRA_TAGS='@smoke' wdio run wdio.browserstack.conf.js
scripts.test:browserstack:regression: npm run clean && CUCUMBER_EXTRA_TAGS='not @smoke' wdio run wdio.browserstack.conf.js
scripts.test:browserstack:admin-tool: npm run clean && BROWSERSTACK_DESKTOP_ONLY=true wdio run wdio.browserstack.conf.js --spec ./test/features/waste-organisation-admin-tool/*.feature --cucumberOpts.tags='@browserstack-admin-tool'
scripts.test:local: . ./env.sh && npm run clean && wdio run wdio.local.conf.js
scripts.test:local:debug: . ./env.sh && npm run clean && DEBUG=true wdio run wdio.local.conf.js
scripts.test:github: npm run clean && wdio run wdio.github.conf.js
scripts.test:github:browserstack: npm run clean && wdio run wdio.github.browserstack.conf.js
scripts.git:pre-commit-hook: npm run format:check && npm run lint
scripts.setup:husky: node -e "try { (await import('husky')).default() } catch (e) { if (e.code !== 'ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND') throw e }" --input-type module
scripts.report:generate: npm run report:generate:allure && npm run report:add:accessibility
scripts.report:clean: rm -rf allure-results && rm -rf allure-report && rm -rf reports
scripts.source:clean:test:report: . ./env.sh && npm run report:clean && npm run test ; npm run report:generate && npm run report:open
